T0522.title: Shadow API
T0522.definition: An undocumented, unmanaged, or deprecated API that remains reachable outside the official API inventory.
T0522.description: Shadow APIs expose the gap between the official API inventory and endpoints that remain reachable in production. They may bypass centralized authentication, rate limits, logging, and data-classification controls. Governance should combine gateway logs, source repositories, OpenAPI files, traffic discovery, and decommissioning workflows to confirm whether each endpoint still has a business purpose and adequate controls.
T0522.usageExample: Assess Shadow API related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
